tenderAddress.blockNumber: Office of the Registrar, Karnataka State Open University, Mukthagangothri, Mysuru

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Detailed Specifications of the Items to be supplied are given in Appendix I

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and Conditions mentioned in the Tender Document are mandatory.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder must have successfully executed at least one Digital Evaluation service for any Government University in Karnataka or Government Department of Karnataka. The bidder shall submit documentary evidence in the form of a Work Order along with a satisfactory performance certificate or Work Completion Certificate issued by the concerned authority. The value of such Work Order should not be less than Rs. 100 lakhs.
The manufacturers authorization form should be submitted for the Web Application Firewall. Manufacturers authorization is mandatory.
The Bidder should have at least 2 certified Engineers, and the certificates should be uploaded.
The Bidder should have ISO9001 certification

The Bidder shall mandatorily submit a detailed Solution Plan covering the implementation, deployment, and maintenance of the Digital Evaluation Software, along with the requisite IT hardware infrastructure, as part of the bid submission. The Bidder shall also provide screenshots of all modules, features and functionalities corresponding to the specifications stipulated in the Technical Specifications, demonstrating compliance with each requirement. The screenshots shall be clearly labelled and mapped to the respective technical specification clause/module for ease of verification and evaluation.
PAN card copy, IT returns statement, Balance sheet, and profit & loss statement of financial year 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26.
Annual turnover statement certified by a CA for the financial years 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26. The average annual turnover of the firm for the last 3 Years should not be less than Rs. 300 lakhs.
